title: Energetic plasticizers for GAP-based formulations with ADN: compatibility and performance evaluation of a nitrofurazanyl ether
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,37006-37011
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA05154A, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Patrick Lieber, Uwe Schaller, Thomas M. Klapötke
NFPEG3N3, a nitrofurazanyl ether plasticizer, is compatible with GAP, HMX and N100 and likely incompatible with ADN; replacing 15 wt% GAP raises volume-specific impulse by 77 N s dm−3 and improves oxygen balance versus Bu-NENA.
